flows.title: Add and verify a domain
steps: In your Resend Dashboard, navigate to the Domains page and click the Add Domain button.
Enter a domain, ideally a subdomain such as notifications.example.com, to use for your Resend emails.
Choose a region from the list provided, closest to the majority of your recipients.
Update your DNS records with the values shown on the Records tab for your domain, using your DNS host provider.
Wait for DNS verification to complete. Your domain usually verifies within 15 minutes of adding the DNS records.

flows.title: View and search email logs
steps: Access your logs from the Logs page in the dashboard.
Use the search bar to find a specific log, useful for tracking down a particular request or debugging an issue.
Filter logs by response status (All Statuses, Successes, Errors, or specific codes) and by date range.
Click a log entry to view its complete request and response details.

flows.title: Add an email address to the suppression list
steps: In the Dashboard, go to the Suppressions page.
Add the address manually by entering it, or import a CSV file with a list of addresses to suppress.
